description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for generating locators in different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#) for use with Playwright testing framework. It includes logic for parsing selectors, handling various locator options, and producing language-specific locator code snippets.

classes.name: JavaScriptLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for JavaScript using Playwright's locator API.

classes.name: PythonLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for Python Playwright bindings.

classes.name: JavaLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for Java Playwright bindings.

classes.name: CSharpLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for C# Playwright bindings.

classes.name: JsonlLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings in JSONL format for serialization or testing.

methods.name: generateLocator
methods.description: Creates a language-specific locator string based on locator type, body, and options.

methods.name: chainLocators
methods.description: Chains multiple locator strings into a single composite locator.

methods.name: regexToString
methods.description: Converts a RegExp object into a language-specific string representation.

methods.name: toCallWithExact
methods.description: Generates a method call string with optional exact matching.

methods.name: toHasText
methods.description: Converts a string or RegExp into a language-specific hasText string.

methods.name: toTestIdValue
methods.description: Converts a string or RegExp into a test ID string representation.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes and quotes a string for code generation.
